text:
sasha: Starting a focused thread to finalize Private Deploy upgrade policy and customer-managed networking fallbacks. Goals: define patch vs minor/major flow, installer UX choice, BGP/relay template, launch gates.

matt: Sales asks near-zero downtime for patch updates. Legal needs egress IP language for relay.

julio: Field request: two customers need IP-preservation post-upgrade and sample BGP configs. They sit behind asymmetric NAT.

kai: Proposed acceptance bullets: 1) patch updates = hotpatch with canary and <1% error rate; 2) minor/major = bundle restart with rollback <= 5m; 3) installer exposes `egress_mode` = direct_peer | relay; 4) KMS rotation + audit demo.

netops: Relay minimal config: `relay_host`, `bgp_asn`, `peer_ip`, `allowed_prefixes`, `tls_cert_id`. Relay must preserve advertised egress IPs and be auditable. Legal to review retention.

matt: Two upgrade primitives: hotpatch (delta apply, keep in-memory KV) vs bundle restart (blue/green). Hotpatch reduces visible downtime but needs kv checksum and ABI checks. Example test CLI: `redwood-operator upgrade --strategy hotpatch --canary 0.05 --verify ./checks/kv-check.sh`.

sasha: Decision: enable hotpatch by default for semver.patch; allow opt-out in installer (records audit). Add `force_restart` flag for deterministic restarts.

kai: Launch gates: A) e2e green on aws+gcp+onprem; B) 3-customer beta 6 weeks; C) runbooks + rollback drills; D) pricing/SLA table for relay add-on.

deploy-bot: Staging: operator-v1.4.3-hotpatch smoke pass gcp-europe-west1 at 2024-08-05T09:40:12Z. kv-checksum: ok, canary-requests:1500, errors:2.

matt: Add `kv-checksum` artifact to CI and cross-version integration tests. Fallback if prototype slips: bundle blue/green for patch channel.

julio: Action items: Sasha -> one-pager scope + patch-compat matrix by Friday; Matt -> hotpatch prototype + tests next Wed; Netops -> BGP + relay template + compliance note by Tue.

sasha: Will circulate one-pager and link here. Installer UX: show "Upgrade Safety Level" (Hotpatch | Bundle) with tooltip.

Thread summary: hotpatch-by-default for patch releases, bundle restart for minor/major, relay-proxy fallback for NAT-only customers, BGP/IP-preservation templates required, acceptance gates set.
